long:
mixlayer is the command line for Mixlayer's OpenAI-compatible API.

Start here:
  mixlayer auth setup          get an API key
  mixlayer doctor              check your key and connection
  mixlayer models list --live-prices
  mixlayer ask "question" --model <model-id>

Compare and save:   ladder, escalate, council, compare, savings
Private data:       shield ask, shield scan, shield redact, vault
Local ledger:       grep, replay, sql
Agents:             --agent, agent setup, agent-context, which

Add --agent to any command for JSON output and no prompts.

agent-context.long:
Outputs a machine-readable description of commands, flags, and auth so
agents can introspect this CLI at runtime without parsing --help or
reading source. Schema is versioned via schema_version.

ask.example: mixlayer ask "Draft a migration plan" --model qwen/qwen3.6-35b-a3b --show-thinking --json

auth set-token.long:
Save an API key to the local credentials file (mode 0600).

Pipe the key on stdin so it stays out of shell history and the process list:

  pbpaste | mixlayer auth set-token
  mixlayer auth set-token - < key.txt

Passing the key as an argument also works but is not recommended.

auth setup.example:
mixlayer auth setup
  mixlayer auth setup --launch

chat.long: Create a chat completion for the given model and messages

council.example: mixlayer council "Pick the safest launch plan" --json

decide.example:
mixlayer decide --model <classification-model> --state-text "Two charges for one order" --noul 'dup=Is this a duplicate charge?' --fail-if 'dup>0.8' --agent
  mixlayer decide --model <classification-model> --state facts.json --questions questions.json --dry-run --agent
decide.long:
Evaluate noul, choice and score questions through POST /v1/systemone.
JSON is returned with --agent or --json; human output is a compact table.
A matching --fail-if condition exits 9 after printing the response.
Other exits: 2 invalid input/HTTP 422, 4 auth/permission, 5 API/capacity (529),
7 rate limit (429), 8 billing (402), 10 configuration.
Retries: at most three retries for 429/529; Retry-After above 30s returns immediately.
Noul values are yes scores, not calibrated confidence probabilities.

decide batch.long:
Evaluate up to --max-rows rows using shared --questions. Outputs JSONL in completion
order with one-based row numbers; malformed and rejected rows do not stop later rows.
Any row failure exits 6 after the summary on stderr. --timeout applies per request.
JSONL rows must be objects; CSV values are strings. --state-field selects one field.
Dry run prints the first request and row count without opening --out or calling HTTP.

doctor.example:
mixlayer doctor
  mixlayer doctor --json
  mixlayer doctor --fail-on warn
  mixlayer doctor --fail-on stale

escalate.example:
mixlayer escalate "Classify these tickets" --confidence 0.85 --json
  mixlayer escalate "Explain this result" --checker jini --checker-model <classification-model> --threshold 0.8 --agent

profile.long:
Profiles capture a set of flag values under a name so a scheduled
agent can invoke the same command with the same configuration each run.

  profile save <name>         captures the current invocation's set flags
  profile use <name>          prints the values (for inspection)
  profile list                lists all saved profiles
  profile show <name>         shows the values of one profile
  profile delete <name>       removes a profile

Use --profile <name> on any command to apply that profile's values.
Explicit flags override profile values.

profile delete.example:
mixlayer profile delete my-defaults --yes
  mixlayer profile delete old-profile --yes --json

profile list.example:
mixlayer profile list
  mixlayer profile list --json

profile save.example:
mixlayer profile save my-defaults --json --compact
  mixlayer profile save tonight-defaults --region US
profile save.long:
Captures every flag explicitly set on the invocation and stores
them under <name>. To update an existing profile, run save again; the
entry is replaced.

To avoid creating empty profiles, at least one non-default flag must be
present (other than --profile, --config, and --home, which are never
captured: they control profile/config resolution and would never apply).

profile show.example:
mixlayer profile show my-defaults
  mixlayer profile show tonight-defaults --json

profile use.example:
mixlayer profile use my-defaults
  mixlayer profile use tonight-defaults --json

shield ask.example: mixlayer shield ask "What segments are at risk?" --data customer-export.csv --json

shield dict add.example: mixlayer shield dict add "Zora Quill" --kind PERSON

shield ingest.example: mixlayer shield ingest big-export.csv -o masked-corpus.csv --manifest tranches.json

shield restructure.example: mixlayer shield restructure customers.csv --bucket --coarsen-dates month --drop email -o safe.csv

sql.example: mixlayer sql "select model, count(*) from runs group by model" --json

which.example:
mixlayer which "stale tickets"
  mixlayer which "bottleneck"
  mixlayer which --limit 1 "send message"
  mixlayer which                                # list the full capability index
which.long:
which resolves a natural-language capability query (for example, "search messages" or "stale tickets") to the best matching command from this CLI's curated feature index.

Exit codes:
  0  at least one match found
  2  no confident match - the query did not score against any indexed capability; fall back to '--help' or 'search' if this CLI has one
